Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary proteomics experiments (Co-IP-MS and GST pull-down-MS) were designed to identify interactors of overexpressed CHIKV nsP4. While the study later uses chemical inhibitors (harringtonolide, MG132) to validate the RACK1-nsP4 axis, these were used for western blot analysis of protein levels, not as the primary variables for the mass spectrometry datasets (PXD047752, PXD047753).
